skills.name: Find Common Denominator
skills.definition: Finding a common denominator and converting unlike fractions to equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract Whole Parts
skills.definition: Subtracting the integer or whole number components of mixed numbers or whole numbers.

skills.name: Subtract Fraction Parts
skills.definition: Subtracting the numerators of the fraction components.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Borrowing from the whole number component when the fractional subtraction yields a negative value.

skills.name: Simplify Fraction
skills.definition: Reducing the resulting fraction to its simplest or lowest terms.
